forward_returns.causality: feature data <= t; labels use data > t

features.rationale: Distance of price from the 20-day trend centre; classical trend-following anchor.
Faster trend-state gauge; responds earlier than SMA20 to direction change.
5-day slope of the 20-day average — trend momentum without price noise.
Fast-vs-slow average alignment; trend strength/regime proxy.
20-day rate of change; the canonical medium-horizon momentum signal.
Overbought/oversold momentum gauge; tests mean-reversion vs continuation stories.
Normalized MACD histogram — momentum with trend crossovers, scale-free.
Per-unit-price daily range; volatility adjusted for price level.
Realized volatility; tests whether low/high vol precedes returns.

features.definition: ranking percentile of realized20 within trailing 252 bars
features.rationale: Cyclical volatility position — distinguishes quiet-from-normal vs extreme-vol episodes.
Relative volume; spike/quiet detection often precedes moves.
Volume trend — accumulation/distribution regime.
Price-volume relationship; trend-confirmed vs diverging moves.
Distance below recent 20-day high (<=0); breakout proximity.
Distance above recent 20-day low (>=0); support proximity.
Normalized distance from the 20-day mean (Bollinger z) — mean-reversion distance gauge.
Distance from 20-bar VWAP anchor (daily proxy; session VWAP unavailable on daily bars).

features.definition: cross-sectional z-score of (close/SMA20-1) across universe at date t
features.rationale: Relative strength within the NIFTY-50 universe; tests cross-sectional ranking alpha.

features.definition: cross-sectional percentile rank of ROC20 across universe at date t
features.rationale: Cross-sectional momentum rank — classic long/short ranking variable.

features.definition: equal-weight universe index 5-day return up to t
features.rationale: Broad-market short-term return; controls for beta/trend-driven future returns.

features.definition: std of equal-weight index daily returns, 20d
features.rationale: Market-wide volatility; regime gauge for the whole cross-section.

fdr_controls.method: Benjamini-Hochberg on VALIDATION p-values of preselected pairs
fdr_controls.note: FINAL-OOS is a holdout scored once, never used for selection.
